label: Outbrain Amplify
terms_note: Amplify API is granted to selected partners by request; tokens valid 30 days; documented rate limits (e.g. 30 requests per second per token).

discovery.auth: basic auth on /login → OB-TOKEN-V1 header (30-day token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** — a complete REST API (marketers, budgets, campaigns, promoted links, reporting) that is
auth: 1. Request API access via the Amplify API beta / partner registration page (select partners).
2. Obtain a token either from the **Amplify API Token page** (after re-entering the password) or `curl -u USERNAME:PASSWORD https://api.outbrain.com/amplify/v0.1/login`.
3. "You must include the token in the HTTP Header 'OB-TOKEN-V1' for all subsequent requests." Tokens are valid for 30 days; `/login` is limited to 2 requests per hour per user.

reference.limits: - 30 requests/second per token; performance reporting 10 requests/minute per marketer; realtime reporting 50/minute per marketer; `/login` 2/hour; HTTP 429 with `rate-limit-msec-left`. - Access by request only; support through the Outbrain Amplify API Google group with the `AMPLIFY-REQUEST-ID` header.
mcp_sdk: None official. Community: Google group `outbrain-amplifyapi`; data-connector sources (dltHub, Daton) prove the reporting surface.

fields.name: ob_token
fields.help: Amplify API token, sent as the OB-TOKEN-V1 header. Obtain it with `curl -u USER:PASSWORD https://api.outbrain.com/amplify/v0.1/login` (Basic auth; the response is {"OB-TOKEN-V1": "…"}); tokens last 30 days, so re-issue and replace it monthly. Amplify API access requires Outbrain's approval.

me.note: GET /marketers: the marketers (advertiser accounts) available to the token's user; there is no user endpoint.

list_accounts.note: GET /marketers: {marketers: [{id, name, enabled, …}], count}. The marketer currency is on its budgets, not on this record.

list_campaigns.note: GET /marketers/{account_id}/campaigns?limit (≤50)&offset: the marketer's non-archived campaigns. `status` is onAirReason (e.g. RUNNING, CAMPAIGN_FLY_DATES_PAST); the enabled flag, cpc and amountSpent are in raw. `budget` is the campaign's budget object amount (a budget can be shared by several campaigns; its type DAILY/MONTHLY/CAMPAIGN is in raw.budget). The `status` argument is not sent.

get_report.note: GET /reports/marketers/{account_id}/periodic?from&to&breakdown=daily&limit=100[&campaignId]: one row per day (up to 100 days per call; totalResults gives the full count), for the marketer or, with campaign_id, one campaign. spend is in the marketer currency; today's figures lag 10–30 minutes. Reporting is limited to 30 requests per minute per marketer and 3 years of history.

pause_resume.note: PUT /campaigns/{campaign_id} {"enabled": false|true} ('Update an Existing Campaign'; enabled is one of the updatable properties). pause sends enabled=false, resume enabled=true; the campaign's onAirReason (in list_campaigns) shows whether it is actually running.

not_offered.update_budget: Budgets are separate entities referenced by campaigns (and possibly shared between them): the amount is changed with PUT /budgets/{budgetId} (https://amplifyv01.docs.apiary.io/#reference/budgets), and the Campaign update does not accept a budget amount ('Only the following Campaign properties are updatable: name, enabled, cpc, targeting…'). The vocabulary's campaign_id is not a budget id.

evidence: host api.outbrain.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 0/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages, 3 by their last segments; every parameter and body key named on the page
